d: Short, wavy crimson hair with bangs and a side part, paired with light blue eyes and a calm, neutral expression on a mature, young adult face. The build is slender, dressed in a white apron over a teal blouse and white skirt, layered with a dark green and black checkered cape featuring a red border and a medical symbol patch. Silver plated armor covers the forearms and hands, complemented by a white nursing cap and white knee-high boots. Accessories include a leather belt with vials and a large white medical kit carried by a handle.
